title: Update your registered surveyor contact details
summary: Learn how to update your contact details for your registered surveyor status with the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI).
intro:
The registration of land and mining surveyors in NSW is the responsibility of the Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI).

You must notify BOSSI if there is a change to:

If BOSSI has your email address or mobile number on record your details will be updated across all your BOSSI registrations.

To check your licence or registration details visit Verify NSW.
what_you_need: Your surveyor licence or registration number

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to update your contact details with BOSSI.

external_links.text: Board of Surveying and Spatial Information

internal_links.text: Replace your registered surveyor identity card

faqs.q: Who is responsible for the registration of land and mining surveyors in NSW?
faqs.a: The Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI) is responsible for the registration of land and mining surveyors in NSW.

faqs.q: What happens if I change my contact details?
faqs.a: If BOSSI has your email address or mobile number on record, your details will be updated across all your BOSSI registrations.

faqs.q: How can I check my licence or registration details?
faqs.a: You can check your licence or registration details by visiting Verify NSW.
